errors.text: The predicted ductility trend is reversed: the target reports an approximately 20.6% increase in fracture strain to 14.0%, whereas the hypothesis predicts that fracture strain remains low or decreases.

The reticulated Laves phase is assigned the opposite dominant role from the target: it is treated as a percolating brittle failure path rather than as a morphology that impedes crack extension and compensates plasticity.
The proposed homogenization anneal is not part of the target processing route, which concerns a vacuum-arc-melted alloy tested in the as-cast condition.

The cited evidence comes from materially different alloy systems and does not substantiate the system-specific phase identity, morphology, phase fraction, lattice contraction, or mechanical-property trends.
